correctness.rationale: Headline claim verified by independent exact recomputation. Scope count 2313 independently recounted (4954 raw prefix words collapsing by trailing-1 identity to 2313, including empty word). PQR formula re-derived for samples and matches alpha_table.json. Full exact D* recomputation over all 2313 irrationals matches tables with 0/2313 mismatches at N=512 and N=1024; 20/20 sampled matches at N=2048 including winner, runner-up, median and worst cases. Winner/runner C, R, words and gaps verified: N=512 gap 1.78642e-08, N=1024 gap 1.86733e-09, N=2048 gap 1.91401e-06, matching DRAFT to stated rounding. Exhaustive exact cross-R sign check proves minimum C-group strictly beats every other C-group at each N (bad=0). Mirror-twin identity proved exactly: P0*R1+P1*R0-R0*R1=0 and Q0*R1+Q1*R0=0, sum alpha0+alpha1=1. Three-distance gap-sum (R,0) and distinct counts verified for winners: {311,201}, {625,399}, {1024,625,399}. s5sign comparator, floor-correction loop, sort order, D* one-sided maxima formula, and cross-R comparison all audited as mathematically correct integer arithmetic over Q(sqrt5); no handbook constant enters proof chain. Minor non-headline defects only: replay.py/enumerate.py/verify.py hardcode output/artifacts/ paths (DRAFT reproduction line says artifacts/...), and N=512 distinct-value line counts distinct C (1233) while distinct exact D* values are 1234 due to one shared-C split across two R values; neither affects headline minima.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp. Nearest priors are asymptotic/metric or higher-dimensional: Hofer/Puchhammer 1611.01288 gives 2D hybrid Halton-Kronecker sharp order/metric bounds under bounded-CF hypotheses, no fixed-N exact table; Abderrahim et al. 2604.00786 optimizes two continuous parameters of 3D Kronecker sets via irace, no 1D bounded-quotient census; Kuipers-Niederreiter gives general Kronecker/Ostrowski/three-distance theory and asymptotics, not the fixed window census; Clement 2406.18132 greedy 1D work confirms the 1D extremal question is active but contains no q<=200 exact census with certified minimizer. Live arXiv API query Kronecker AND discrepancy returns 28 hits; inspected entries are hybrids, digital/function-field analogues, metrical bounds, or 3D optimization, all disjoint from the noble-tail q<=200 N=512/1024/2048 exact-minimum table. No source records or mechanically implies the exact winner words, C pairs, R values, or 1.8e-08/1.9e-09/1.9e-06 gaps; asymptotics do not determine fixed-N separated minima. Scope (noble numbers with bounded prefix, q<=200) is a recognized badly-approximable subclass, not a rename or parameter substitution of the failed 2D cubic-vector attempt.

value.rationale: Strongest self-contained headline claim is an exact invariant of a specific natural object: separated star-discrepancy minima (twin pair up to x->1-x mirror symmetry) over the 2313 noble-tail badly-approximable irrationals at dyadic QMC sizes N=512,1024,2048, with explicit witnesses, exact C pairs, R denominators, and certified gaps. Object and invariant were motivated before computation (Roth/Schmidt lower bounds, bounded-partial-quotient theory, QMC benchmark selection, three-distance structure); values were not known or mechanically implied by asymptotics; a future researcher selecting a finite-N low-discrepancy Kronecker benchmark could reasonably need the precise witness. Full tables plus reusable exact Q(sqrt5) pipeline are a citable fragment. Honestly scoped as noble-tail subset with twin-pair uniqueness, finite-N only, and thin-but-exact N=1024 gap. Per value guidance, one exact witness/datum of this form is independently retrievable and not rejected merely for narrowness; incomplete full-quotient-4 census does not erase headline value.

decisive_checks: Independent recount: 4954 raw words over {1,2,3,4} with convergent denominator q<=200 collapse by stripping trailing 1s to 2313 canonical words including empty word; matches alpha_table.json.
Re-derived alpha=(P+Q sqrt5)/R formula from prefix convergents and phi=(1+sqrt5)/2; spot-checked records match exactly; all 0<alpha<1, Q in {+-2}.

Full independent exact D* recomputation (floors by float guess plus A+B sqrt5 sign tests, exact sort, one-sided maxima as (C1+C2 sqrt5)/(RN)): 0/2313 C-mismatches at N=512 and N=1024; 20/20 sampled matches at N=2048.
Exhaustive exact cross-R separation: winner C-group vs every other C-group strictly positive via s5sign(dA,dB) at all three N (bad=0); decimal gaps 1.78642e-08, 1.86733e-09, 1.91401e-06 match DRAFT.
Exact mirror-twin proof: winner pairs satisfy P0*R1+P1*R0-R0*R1=0 and Q0*R1+Q1*R0=0 (alpha0+alpha1=1) with shared R (24764; 71804); D* C pairs identical within pair.
Three-distance verification: circular gap sums exactly (R,0); winner distinct counts 2,2,3 with multiplicities {311,201}, {625,399}, {1024,625,399} as claimed.
